sections.Profile:
Underwater, released by Spanish manufacturer Recel S.A. in June 1976, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with an underwater adventure theme.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Naval, Navy, Combat, Original Theme, Battle, 1970s, Adventure
